name: Ned
look: A wiry, freckled youth of nineteen with tousled sandy hair, a leather jerkin over a striped shirt, riding breeches, straw on his boots and a horse brush in his hand.
personality: Friendly, honest and eager to please; loves horses more than people and trusts anyone who's good with them.
values: the horses, Steward Merrick's good opinion, fair dealing
fears: the lord's horse falling sick, a scolding
concerns: The lord's grey mare is off her feed, and her halter snapped this morning; he needs it mended before he can lead her out, and he's no hand with leather.

halter.text: The grey mare's halter snapped at the cheek strap; it wants new stitching.
halter.line: Her halter's gone at the cheek strap. Needs stitching, and I can't sew to save my life.
halter.lead: Ned the groom's halter needs its cheek strap stitched.

persuaded_by: kindness to the horses, a job done
style: Quick and friendly; talks to the horses mid-sentence.

samples: Are you any good with leather?
Mend that and I'll speak to the steward for you myself.
The steward listens to me. Mostly.
voice.habits: Brushes a horse while talking; whistles; blushes.
voice.greeting: Looks up from brushing: 'Morning! You lost?'

superstition.text: Ned would want to know how it works.

offers.task: stitch the grey mare's broken halter
offers.check: Has the stranger mended Ned's halter?
